repos.description: PiDoorbell - home automation using RaspberryPi, Proximity sensor, GPIO
Home automation: Light that turns on when somebody is standing still in front of the mirror

Offline AI firmware for ESP32-S3 that converts natural-language commands into safe hardware automation rules. It runs a compact local model, supports Persian and English, controls GPIO and sensors through a constrained DSL, and works without cloud APIs or constant internet access.
